title: Morning or Afternoon Berlin Walking Tour - Quick Summary
items: **Choose from hard time limits first.** Use the earliest time you can reach the World Clock and the latest time you must be free near Hackescher Markt.
**Morning protects the afternoon.** It suits visitors already in Berlin who want lunch and one substantial plan after the roughly 2-hour walk.
**Afternoon protects the arrival.** It suits a slower start, a morning commitment or an arrival day with luggage and hotel time.
The current calendar can show 11:30 and 15:30 on bookable dates, but availability is date-specific. Always check the live calendar.
If both fit, pick the day shape you want. If neither fits with a 5-minute arrival buffer, choose another date instead of rushing.
